engine3d.title: Engine teardown
engine3d.subtitle: Honda K24 i-VTEC, part by part

engine3d.canvasLabel: Interactive exploded view of an inline-four engine. Drag to rotate. The parts list holds a link for every component.

valveCover.name: Valve cover
valveCover.note: Closes the top end and keeps the oil where it belongs.

camshafts.name: Camshafts
camshafts.note: Two shafts open the valves. The tall middle intake lobe is the VTEC high cam.

camGears.name: Cam gears
camGears.note: Phase each camshaft against the crank. The intake gear carries the variable-timing actuator.

rockerArms.name: VTEC rocker arms
rockerArms.note: A locking pin joins the three intake rockers at high rpm.

cylinderHead.name: Cylinder head
cylinderHead.note: Combustion chambers, ports and valve seats in one casting.

valves.name: Valves & springs
valves.note: Four valves per cylinder: two intake, two exhaust.

headGasket.name: Head gasket
headGasket.note: A layered steel seal between block and head.

block.name: Engine block
block.note: The cast cylinder block with 87 mm bores and five main bearings.

pistons.name: Pistons & rings
pistons.note: Aluminium pistons with a three-ring pack seal the combustion.

conrods.name: Connecting rods
conrods.note: Forged I-beam rods link each piston to the crank.

crankshaft.name: Crankshaft
crankshaft.note: Counterweights balance the throws and turn piston thrust into torque.

oilPan.name: Oil pan
oilPan.note: The sump that holds the engine oil.

intakeManifold.name: Intake manifold
intakeManifold.note: Splits the air from the throttle body into four runners.

exhaustManifold.name: Exhaust manifold
exhaustManifold.note: Collects the burnt gas from four ports into one outlet.

timingChain.name: Timing chain
timingChain.note: A roller chain drives both camshafts from the crank.
